title: Elon Musk on Joe Rogan denies advanced tech

tellings.quote: Now Elon Musk recently said on Joe Rogan he has an all access pass through Lockheed and Northrup and we don't have any of these technologies.

plain: The tech businessman Elon Musk said on the podcast of Joe Rogan, a popular interviewer, that he has an all-access pass through Lockheed and Northrop, two big American defense and aerospace companies, and that "we don't have any of these technologies." Michels brings this up himself in a 2025 episode with Steven Greer, a man who says UFO secrets are kept by a global ring of insiders. Musk's words stand as a denial that hidden advanced craft exist.
